findings.current: the keen insight of the Chief and Woo Jintae

findings.current: “Ha-ha, Jintae, you haven’t forgotten me, have you?”
findings.explanation: The speaker addresses him as 우 소협, not Jintae.
findings.korean: “하하, 우 소협, 날 잊은 건 아니겠지요?”
findings.replacement: “Ha-ha, Young Hero Woo, you haven’t forgotten me, have you?”

findings.explanation: The speaker again uses 우 소협 rather than his personal name.
findings.korean: “우 소협도 참, 저희를 너무 무시하는 것 아니에요?”
findings.replacement: “You really underestimate us, Young Hero Woo.”
